title: Humanoid HUB aimbot esp
features:
Description:
Yo. I finally got rid of the FPS drops from the old GUI versions and fixed that annoying distance limit BS. V2 is a pure RAW script now. It runs completely in the background and is smooth as butter.

I completely broke the ESP distance limits using math.huge. As long as the game engine hasn't completely despawned the player, you will see them across the entire map. Plus, it's a Universal engine, so it works on almost any standard Roblox game.

🔥 V2 Features & Changelog:

Infinite Range ESP: Box, Name, Distance, and Health Bar. The distance limit is completely trashed.

Prediction Aimbot (RMB): Tired of shooting behind running targets? The engine now calculates player velocity (0.045 prediction) and aims slightly ahead of them. Guaranteed headshots.

Sticky Aim Fix: Fixed that seizure-inducing glitch where the aimbot snaps to another target walking by. Once it locks, it stays locked until you let go of Right Click.

Max FPS Optimization: Removed heavy while wait() UI loops. Uses pure Drawing API. Zero lag, even on potato PCs.

How to use:
Just execute the script, grab the key from the sleek UI, paste it, and hit Verify. The menu will close with a clean animation and the engine will start running instantly.

Go dominate your lobbies. Drop a like if it works for you, and let me know in the comments if any specific game breaks it. Enjoy! 🚀
